# FileMind

> FileMind is an AI-powered PDF manager and semantic document search platform that enables instant understanding, verifiable page citations, and hardware-bound biometric document security.

## Summary

FileMind combines vector embeddings with full-text search to index and search across extensive PDF documents in milliseconds. Every answer provided includes exact page citations and source excerpts.

## Core Capabilities

- **AI PDF Management**: Upload, organize, and categorize complex multi-page PDF documents.
- **Semantic Vector Search**: Ask questions in natural language and receive direct answers linked to page numbers.
- **Hardware-bound Biometric Vault**: Envelope encryption using AES-256-GCM and FIDO2 WebAuthn (Windows Hello / Touch ID).
- **Secure Document Sharing**: Share documents via unguessable public links with expiration controls or restricted to authenticated recipients.
- **Privacy-first Architecture**: Zero training guarantee — private files are never used to train public AI models.
